title: An intrinsic cytoskeletal oscillator establishes neuronal polarity.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed both Zenodo records via API. Record 20118606 (CC-BY-4.0) holds SourceData.zip (5.3 MB), code, and 16 per-figure image zips of 44 MB to 8.2 GB each (about 50 GB in total). Downloaded and opened SourceData.zip: 5 Excel workbooks, about 130 sheets, one per figure panel. Each sheet holds per-cell or per-event summaries (e.g. Fig 2j: 330 rows of mean extension duration with cell, batch and group columns), a few representative time series (Fig 1b: 4 neurites from one neuron), or averaged cross-correlation curves. Record 20081075 holds only tomography software.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The data availability statement says the Zenodo images are only representative, and that the full raw and processed image data sit in a DZNE (German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases) archive, available only on request. Per-panel sample sizes (e.g. n = 98 neurons, 509 neurites of 73 neurons) came from the figure legends; the source-data row counts I opened are consistent with them.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked in files and text: Zenodo has the source-data spreadsheets plus representative raw images only. The full raw imaging dataset and the processed per-neurite tracks are 'upon request' from the lead contact.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in files: no table links each neurite's growth time series to its eventual fate (axon or dendrite). The only candidate label, axon versus minor neurite, would have to be built by re-segmenting and tracking neurons in the multi-GB time-lapse images.

a3_inputs_present.note: Checked in files: the inputs in the spreadsheets are per-cell summary statistics or averaged curves, not per-neurite feature vectors. Usable inputs exist only as raw microscopy movies.

a4_units_stated.note: Checked in files: almost every sheet has a 'Units:' line (µm/min, min, µm, z-score, Pearson r).

a5_enough_rows.note: Checked in files: the largest sheets with a biology-relevant grouping hold hundreds of rows over roughly 20 to 150 neurons per panel, from 3 to 5 experiments. The few large sheets (e.g. 30,633 rows in ED Fig 6e) are patch lifetimes, not a prediction target.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: About 50 GB of image zips on Zenodo (single figures up to 8.2 GB); source data 5.3 MB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Checked via Zenodo API: any real ML task needs the raw time-lapse images, which are far over the 5 GB working-set limit and partly not public.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Spot-checked: source-data row counts are consistent with the legend sample sizes (e.g. about 100 rows for the n = 98 periodogram panel in ED Fig 1g).

a8_label_provenance.note: Values are direct image measurements (lengths, velocities, intensities), not model predictions. But no prediction label exists to trace.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: Part A failed. At best a model would predict which neurite becomes the axon from early growth-and-actin dynamics, in cultured mouse or rat neurons from one lab, and only if the raw tracks were released.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the early stop-start growth pattern of each young neuron branch to predict which branch will become the axon.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-branch time series of growth speed and tip actin signal from time-lapse microscopy of young neurons; the public spreadsheets have only roughly 20 to 150 neurons per panel, and per-branch tracks are not public.
plain_idea.predict: Whether each branch becomes the axon or a dendrite, judged later by its length and Tau staining (Tau is an axon marker) in the same imaged neuron.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: It would test whether axon choice can be read out from the soma-driven oscillation before it happens. But the needed per-branch tracks are not public.

ml_idea: Classify neurite fate (axon or dendrite) from early growth-velocity and actin-wave time series. This is blocked: the public files hold only per-panel summary statistics and representative images, and the full tracks are available on request only.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: Part A failed. The working set is the sum of Zenodo image zip sizes from the API.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open SourceData.zip and look for a per-neurite table with a fate label. Done: none exists.

verdict_reason: A cell-biology imaging paper. The public source data are per-figure summary spreadsheets with roughly 20 to 150 neurons per panel, and there is no per-neurite fate label table. Full raw image data is available on request only, and the public representative images total about 50 GB. Fails A1, A2, A3, A5 and A6.
